# codebase-agentgpt

AgentGPT-derived experiment. Archive; no code reuse expected.

## Stack & contents

Next.js / TypeScript with Prisma. ~66 files under `code/AgentGPT/{src,prisma,aws}`. Snapshot of the `TrajanWJ/AgentGPT` fork with AWS CloudFormation deploy assets.

## Why this is here

Marked as a fork in `github-legacy-repos`. Donor of the **autonomous agent loop** pattern (`src/components/AutonomousAgent.ts`) — useful as a known-bad baseline to compare against EMA's explicit-lineage approach.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-agentgpt:code/AgentGPT/src/components/AutonomousAgent.ts
git show origin/codebase-agentgpt:code/AgentGPT/prisma/schema.prisma
```
